lines: STIG compliance: 4 CAT I open; 4 findings closed this week
SITEA - RHEL 9: CAT I 1, CAT II 8, CAT III 2, ▼ Better: 4 closed, 1 opened
SITEA - VMware: CAT I 0, CAT II 3, CAT III 0, ▬ Same: 0 closed, none opened
SITEA - Windows Server: CAT I 3, CAT II 4, CAT III 1, ▲ Worse: 0 closed, 1 opened
A finding is a rule Open on an asset, as STIG Manager has it now. Nothing is written to STIG Manager.
Since last week: this run against the run of 6 to 8 days ago, rule by rule. Closed is the hosts a rule is open on fewer, opened the hosts it is open on more.
A rule closed on one host and opened on another in the same week counts as neither.
A collection that was not in last week's run is "New here" and is not in the week's totals.
Fixed on the host, still Open: the STIG drift reports' last scans against this run's Open findings.
Compared with the run of 2026-11-06 06:02 UTC.
